title: The life cycle of corn
description: A maize sporophyte has a tassel and an ear shoot. In two parallel tracks, diploid microsporocytes and megasporocytes undergo meiosis. Haploid microspores develop by mitosis into pollen with two sperm nuclei. One surviving megaspore develops by mitosis into an embryo sac with an egg and two polar nuclei. Double fertilization produces a diploid embryo and triploid endosperm in the mature kernel. Growth by mitosis returns to the mature sporophyte. Anatomical stages and nuclei are schematic and not to scale.
